short: Integral kernel derivatives at inert primes

lean.name: Formalism.L2.KerInert.JetsInert
lean.plain: Integral kernel derivatives at inert primes
lean.note: This proposition asserts integrality of the theta-kernel jets for admitted lattices at inert primes $p\ge 5$. Lean derives it under auxiliary hypotheses on the local model and bases. The compiled RH proof uses kernel integrality and a separate jet bound to obtain divisibility of the periods.
